region_scene_page.compact: A chiming guitar-pop road where 12-string brightness, harmony, and folk-song clarity prepare the ground for folk-rock and later indie jangle.
region_scene_page.standard: The Searchers and Hollies show the British guitar-pop side; The Byrds turn the sound into a Los Angeles folk-rock engine. The shared thread is sparkle, not weight: ringing guitars, close harmonies, and songs that seem to float even when the beat is firm. The archetype sits between beat groups and folk-rock: less raw than garage, less orchestral than baroque pop, and more guitar-texture-driven than harmony pop alone.
